question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
-- Now calculate average new unicorn companies per year for Fintech from 2019-2021
SELECT 
    AVG(new_companies) as avg_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM (
    SELECT 
        year_founded,
        COUNT(*) as new_companies
    FROM companies_dates cd
    JOIN companies_industries ci ON cd.company_id = ci.company_id
    WHERE year_founded BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
      AND ci.industry = 'Fintech'
    GROUP BY year_founded
)
